column6: The back-translation changes 'foundational' to 'essential' and 'ability' to 'power,' which alters the specific categories of attributes and their implications regarding God's nature, potentially affecting the understanding of His attributes.
column7: The attributes are grouped into relational, moral, foundational, ability categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Foundational attributes describe His essential nature of being.
column8: Attributes are divided into relational, moral, essential, and power categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Essential attributes describe His true nature of being.
